svg.text: Learning card box A7 – assembly instructions
Sanduku la kadi za kujifunzia A7 – maelekezo ya kuunganisha
Leitner box, 5 compartments · 6 mm plywood · outside 386 × 121 × 65 mm
· Wood glue (white PVA, D2 or D3)
· Gundi ya mbao (nyeupe, PVA, D2 au D3)
· Msasa namba 120 na 180, kipande cha kusugulia
· Nyundo ya mbao au ya mpira
· 2 clamps or a strap, try square
· Damp cloth, small stick to spread glue
· Kitambaa chenye unyevu, kijiti cha kupaka gundi
NgarumaVTC · parts milled by M+M Fräsdienstleistungen, Kappeln (Germany)
